meta.price_selection_rule: Only current rows count: the latest observed_date for a shop and item, with an exact price, for a menu item on sale now. Add-ons, surcharges, gifts, merchandise and groceries are not menu items, and a price with a service charge of unstated rate is left out. One price per shop per item. Where a shop lists the item under several price_basis values, takeaway wins, then dine_in, then online_order; within the winning basis the cheapest product is used.
